description: Source-level exclusive-grid gates integrated in feature branch. Static tests do not establish runtime/security completeness.

generations.name: Stadt NexVerse - Generation 1
generations.public_distribution_security_blocker: HTTP login sends credentials without end-to-end TLS unless a secure supported proxy path is deployed

notes: Generation 1 login URI is compiled into the current feature branch; exact live authentication and redirect behavior still require staging verification.
The public v1 OGL discovery endpoint must never override the approved XML-RPC login URI or advertise unavailable native login.
Gen2 is intentionally disabled and no G2 authentication or CAP state exists in the current source.
Viewer-side allowlisting is not server-side authentication or a copy-protection mechanism.
Password transmission over HTTP is a deployment security risk; published release should require a verified TLS-enabled login route before authentication.
